FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Pavement Pros Asphalt Services specializes in providing high-quality asphalt paving and maintenance solutions for residential and commercial properties. Our core operations include asphalt installation for driveways, parking lots, and roadways, as well as resurfacing and repair services. We prioritize using durable materials and modern equipment to ensure long-lasting results. Our team is committed to safety and has a documented safety program in place with regular employee training on equipment use. We also maintain strong vendor relationships to secure a steady supply of asphalt and aggregates, ensuring our projects run smoothly and efficiently. With a focus on quality and customer satisfaction, we handle all aspects of paving projects, providing clear communication and effective project management systems to meet deadlines and client expectations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not have a history of frequent or severe employee injury claims and confirms its commitment to safety and compliance. We do not engage in paving operations at commercial airports and have no unresolved environmental violations. Additionally, we maintain business interruption coverage for any weather-related operational delays.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, during the resurfacing of a commercial parking lot, a minor accident occurred when a piece of asphalt fell from our equipment and caused slight damage to a parked vehicle, resulting in a loss of $1,200. The claim has been settled and closed as of April 5, 2023.  On May 23, 2023, an employee sustained a minor injury while operating equipment, leading to a loss of $3,800 due to medical expenses and workers' compensation. This claim is currently under review by our insurance provider.
